scenes.heading: Building a network of reliable vendors and contractors

sents.d: Building a network of reliable vendors and contractors
A trusted vendor network protects timelines and quality on every deal.

Both agents and investors regularly need reliable inspectors, contractors, photographers, and other service providers — building relationships with vetted vendors before you urgently need one under deadline pressure prevents scrambling later.

Asking other agents or investors for their trusted vendor recommendations, rather than choosing based on advertising alone, tends to surface more reliable providers since the referral carries real reputational weight.
Maintaining these relationships even between projects (occasional check-ins, sending them business when appropriate) keeps you a priority client when you do need fast turnaround on short notice.

take: Line up vetted vendors before you need them.
